color.$description: Semantic color roles and status roles, with the default theme's values.

background.$description: The page background, the base surface.

card.$description: The background of cards, the raised surface.

popover.$description: The background of popovers and menus, the overlay surface.

primary.$description: The solid background of primary actions.

accent.$description: The background of hovered and selected items.

accentForeground.$description: Text on hovered and selected items.

destructive.$description: The solid background of destructive actions.

success.$description: The solid background of success states.

warning.$description: The solid background of warning states.

info.$description: The solid background of informational states.

scrim.$description: The veil behind dialogs, sheets and drawers.

surface.$description: Surface levels from the page up, with the default theme's values.

raised.$description: Cards and panels above the page.

overlay.$description: Popovers, menus and dialogs above everything else.

swatch.$description: One swatch per colorful preset, the colors an object marked with it takes, with the default theme's values.

text.$description: Text styles at the medium text size with 16px body text, scaled by the person's text size.

largeTitle.$description: Large titles at the top of a view.

weight.$description: Font weights after the CSS font-weight keywords and their common names.

space.$description: Spacing steps, scaled by the scaling and density.

size.$description: Control heights, scaled by the scaling and density.

width.$description: Widths of panels and overlays, scaled by the scaling and density.

sidebarIcon.$description: A sidebar's width while it shows its icons.

prose.$description: The widest a block of centred text runs, such as an empty state's.

row.$description: The narrowest a horizontal attachment row runs.

radius.$description: Corner radii, scaled by the scaling and the theme's radius.

full.$description: Pill corners under the full radius, square corners otherwise.

stroke.$description: Line widths of borders and focus rings, unscaled so hairlines stay sharp.

border.$description: Borders of controls, cards and separators.

shadow.$description: Elevation shadows of the surface levels.

edge.$description: The hairline around raised and overlaid surfaces, the gray's alpha steps 3 and 6.

cast.$description: The cast shadow color, black's alpha steps 2 and 6.

inset.$description: Sunken fields such as text inputs.

raised.$description: Raised surfaces such as cards and buttons.

overlay.$description: Overlaid surfaces such as popovers and dialogs.

motion.$description: Durations and easings, collapsed to zero by the person's motion setting.

short.$description: Small changes such as hover and press.

spring.$description: Playful movement with a slight overshoot, sampled from a spring as linear(), with an overshooting cubic Bézier as its portable form.
